activity: Initial quiet readiness; retain entry/before/after/terminal host observations. As in the accepted Cargo-parent protocol, background activity never selects or rejects instruction samples based on effect. No native elapsed claim.

authority.note: A separate exact-input Root release is required; current instruction and native-wall authorities do not cover this witness.

child_environment: Keep the exact ordinary native Cargo environment and live jobserver. No instrumentation preload. Retain ordered compiler environments; only original accepted jobserver descriptor comparison omission applies.

cold_cache.retirement: Unchanged same-filesystem private-cache retirement after untimed before-build; original primary and numbered cold banks preserved.
cold_cache.total_write_or_syscall_count_claimed: Only after complete raw trace and payload reconciliation; otherwise lower bound only.

decision_table.condition: All numeric PID files decode, a single cache-mutating PID supplies complete payload writes and commits, and final committed slot bytes reconcile
decision_table.decision: Report exact successful logical write total, commit count, partial/failed writes and last payload reconciliation.

decision_table.condition: Any syscall is undecodable, ordering is ambiguous, or observed mutations are unsupported
decision_table.decision: Preserve raw evidence and restoration; retain only the independently verified footprint lower bound and name the missing proof. No replacement witness.

endpoint_entry: Separate exact Root authority, accepted two-host warm primary, authenticated independent witness-bank copies and copied zero-work freshness.
masking: No Callgrind profile or native-wall result is read; trace parsing is operational only.
metric: Successful cache-temp write/writev/pwrite bytes and successful commit renames; no instruction or elapsed comparison.
metric_integrity: All numeric PID files, local ordering, fd paths, payload reconstruction, commit renames and final slot bytes must reconcile. No Callgrind or elapsed metric.
native: No native wall time or comparative claim; raw diagnostic command receipts retained without scalar duration inspection.
preflight: One single native syscall capture per arm, after exact copied-bank zero-work freshness; original Cargo argv/environment and output/diagnostic/context guards.

producer.binary_pair: The exact production pair accepted by root-build-acceptance-01.json; identical artifacts on both hosts.
producer.physical_paths: one common source/target path for both builds
producer.toolchain: stock Rust 1.99; actual matched build and focused/corpus correctness require Root acceptance

profiler_prerequisite.required: All original profiling tools remain exact, but no profiler is executed in this witness.

purpose: One separately traced cold-cache baseline and candidate check per VM, on new private copied banks; exact logical temp-file bytes and commits where provable.

registry_cache.candidate: After the untimed before-build, atomically move the existing private cache into this execution’s retained-cache directory. Require no private cache immediately before the actual endpoint and committed records afterward.
registry_cache.witness_scope: Magic, key-to-slot relation, bounded private regular files and supported JSON shape; no independent keyed-BLAKE3 or hit-count claim.

state_banks: New independent state-bank/write-witness-check/{arm}; same active paths. Copies authenticate to each arm's own pristine primary bank.
workload_edit: Use the exact accepted donor fixture: append a deterministic ordinary non-doc comment, warm its state=before form, then change it to state=after_. The strings have equal length and five changed bytes. All Rust tokens and source positions remain unchanged. Restore the original source afterward; no production uv change.
workload_tools: Published SDK12 f93 Rust/rustdoc and fixed Wild execute uv, distinct from the stock producer compiler. Only Cargo varies.
